description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Magic Pot that is a 1/1 Soldier and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Magic Pot token and the Thopter, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Magic Pot token dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Thopter, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
